card.name: Covered-by-clothing application area phrase
card.fires_on: Words just before or inside the phrase 'covered by the patient's short sleeve t-shirt' in topical-application instructions. Also fires on a few scattered web words such as a comma in a list of frog genera or 'like' before sprinklers.

modes.label: Short sleeve t-shirt coverage
modes.description: Words in 'the area that will be covered by a short sleeve t-shirt' in application-area instructions.
modes.example: Area of application should be limited to the area that will be covered<< by>> the patient's short sleeve t-shirt.

modes.description: Isolated linking words or punctuation in unrelated web or reference text, such as a comma in a list of genus names or a citation year digit.
